properties.name: shop.items-per-page
properties.description: Number of products shown per page on the shop and product-listing views.

properties.name: shop.minio.endpoint
properties.description: Hostname of the MinIO (or MinIO-compatible) server used for product image storage.

properties.name: shop.minio.port
properties.description: Port the MinIO server listens on.

properties.name: shop.minio.secure
properties.description: Whether to connect to MinIO over HTTPS instead of plain HTTP.

properties.name: shop.minio.access-key
properties.description: Access key used to authenticate with MinIO.

properties.name: shop.minio.secret-key
properties.description: Secret key used to authenticate with MinIO.

properties.name: shop.minio.bucket
properties.description: Name of the MinIO bucket product images are uploaded to; created automatically on startup if it doesn't already exist.

properties.name: shop.stripe.secret-key
properties.description: Stripe secret API key. Leave blank to run with payments disabled (checkout falls back to a plain "Place Order" button).

properties.name: shop.stripe.publishable-key
properties.description: Stripe publishable key exposed to the checkout page's client-side Stripe Checkout widget.

properties.name: shop.upload.dir
properties.description: Local filesystem directory served at /uploads/** by WebConfig.
